name: Restore the authenticated NJAMA GROUP workspace
description: Verifies the existing authenticated owner reaches the redesigned group command centre without a sign-in loop.
steps: Sign in with the existing NJAMA GROUP owner account
Wait for session restoration and the opening sequence
Confirm the group workspace and navigation are visible
expected: The existing owner reaches NJAMA GROUP with the expected role and no blank screen.

name: Navigate all group areas with Back and Next
description: Verifies the new group areas remain within the parent application and history controls work.
steps: Open Businesses
Open Finance
Open NJAMA INTELLIGENCE
Use Back and confirm Finance appears
Use Next and confirm NJAMA INTELLIGENCE appears
expected: Back and Next restore the visited sections and do not leave NJAMA GROUP.

name: Protect unprovisioned business and finance records
description: Verifies that when persistent table catalogs are unavailable, business and financial forms are visibly gated and no fabricated records are displayed.
steps: Sign in as the group owner
Open Businesses and inspect the data-provisioning notice
Open Finance and inspect the transaction form
Confirm live record submission is disabled while catalogs are unavailable
expected: The app clearly explains the provisioning requirement, does not invent balances or records, and blocks writes until the database is ready.

name: Use NJAMA INTELLIGENCE without false live-data claims
description: Verifies the assistant returns useful group-specific guidance while disclosing that subsidiary data connections are not active.
steps: Open NJAMA INTELLIGENCE
Ask for three priorities for building the group
Review the returned response
expected: A useful response appears and does not claim access to live subsidiary records or execution authority.

name: Keep the command centre usable on mobile
description: Verifies the redesigned group command centre remains usable at mobile width.
steps: Open NJAMA GROUP on a mobile viewport
Open the navigation drawer
Navigate to Departments and Finance
Use the in-app Back control
expected: Navigation, cards, forms and history controls remain usable without horizontal overflow.

name: Show the founding portfolio and group departments
description: Verifies the agreed founding businesses and group functions are represented distinctly from existing standalone apps.
steps: Open Businesses and inspect the founding portfolio
Open Departments and inspect the seven shared functions
Open Technology and inspect the separate existing application links
expected: Quick Task Errands & Cleaning Services, Njama Creations and Njama Property Managers appear as the founding businesses; existing apps are shown as separate systems without shared data.

name: Enforce team invitation and approval authority
description: Verifies team access and approval controls are role-aware and enforced by backend routes.
steps: Sign in as the group owner
Open People and inspect the member invitation form
Open Governance and inspect the approval register
Confirm backend authorization is required for invitation and decision actions
expected: Only authorized owner or admin roles can invite members or decide approvals; business scope is enforced server-side.
